name: Little Garden Helper
source:
You've bought flower seeds from a strange old woman at a ridiculous price. But, you're excited to grow the star of your garden for the spring. They're just flowers aren't they?

[From [url=https://afuera.itch.io/little-garden-helper]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你以高得离谱的价格从一位陌生的老妇人那里买了花种。但是，你很高兴能在春天种植花园里的明星。它们只是花，不是吗？

[来自[url=https://afuera.itch.io/little-garden-helper]Itch.io[/url]]
